notes.title: Update v2.0 [New puzzles, New Achievments, Music]
notes.content:
Hello everyone.
I present the new update of OS:Path, the 2.0 version!

The main features are: new puzzles, music, 2 new achievements and GUI improvement. 
It took quite a lot of time to finish this update, so I hope that you'll like it.
Thanks for your support. If you found a bug or you want to help translate the game to your language, contact me on Steam, [url=https://twitter.com/GooDMage95]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/h7rMacq]Discord[/url].
Price went up two times the previous one.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32526057/48cc990232087882e10b1d34d14f4d144c29fc90.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32526057/726571f842d3823801e7260dd7e7d610961b602d.png[/img]

[h1]There were added:[/h1]
[list][*]A lot of new puzzles
[*]2 achievements ["Illuminati", "True engineer"] 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32526057/374dfb15c5079e1f26344c460f15eec62bd85fb6.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32526057/2f131e2613574896064d87d1497a380b50a50a03.png[/img]
[*]Music
[*]Social networks' links
[*]Ability to change scale on the map using Ctrl
[*]A new path for saving options and saves to avoid conflicts with previous ones. Now you can play the old version without damaging the new one's saves.
[/list]

[h1]Improvements:[/h1]
[list][*]The game now is ~3 times its previous length
[*]SUPER GUI improvement
[b]old:[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32526057/b37dfd57fa24a6f925ac6ba96c29c27be3939bda.png[/img]

[b]new:[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32526057/cf4ed5ffd4a91a3f1f717d3b617266357b707558.png[/img]

[*]Graphics improvement (the ship stage)
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32526057/8bd9ad42f2eee4965cf52c6ac7aa9b9d5f28d2b2.png[/img]

[*]Text output was speeded up 2 times the previous speed
[*]Journal's working logic improvement
[*]... and lots of minor improvements and bugfixes.
[/list]

[h1]You can also install the previous version:[/h1]
1. Right click on OS:Path on your library. 
2. Select tab Beta version. 
3. Select "1.2" branch.

notes.title: **Working on new update OS:Path v2.0**
notes.content:
Now game has ultraviolet mode :з
Also more puzzles and other cool features were added.
I'm planning to finish the update before the end of the week.

Anyway, I almost finished everything, what's left is to polish the game a bit and wait until my foreign friends will help me with translating it to other languages. 

P.S. The price will go up to 2-3 times after the update (it's a really big one, you could say that I wrote a new game :D)
If you haven't get the game yet, it's about time :з

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32526057/27a05c5b7a8fc3d02fcc331eb201d733d6e4ae76.png[/img]

notes.title: Update v1.1 [Bugfixes, Repair icon, German translation]
notes.content:
Hi!
New update available!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32526057/dfcf5bc10879bbef359917edcc0f25ab279cd1f5.gif[/img]

[h1]Bugfixes:[/h1]
	Fixed repeating keystroke on MacOS.
	Fixed save and options can't load on MacOS and Linux.
		
[h1]Improvements:[/h1]
	Added repair icon. Shows more clearly that the module is not active and repairs are required.
	Time between screens transition now equals 300ms instead of 500 ms.
	Render optimization: icons and LED.
		
[h1]Localization:[/h1]
	Added German translation, by Hanni.
	Thanks to him!
